{{Top|leg}}
An '''AG droid''' was a small labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One was reprogrammed and dispatched to plane the snow off a ramshackle hospital's roof in order to prevent the roof collapsing.
